爱莎贝儿-148CM-L 粉肤 RAD049 风间红叶Kazama Momiji-透裙的诱惑
女朋友站在镜前，你看着那件荧粉色紧身连衣裙穿在她身上几乎透明。
昨夜你亲手缠绕在她雪白肌肤上的粉色捆绑绳若隐若现，勒出诱人的红痕。
她冲你眨眼，笑着说：“今晚还等我回来解开吗？”空气中弥漫着暧昧的余温。
胸型：148CM-L 粉肤

Elsa Babe-148CM-L Pink RAD049 Kazama Momiji-The Temptation of a Sheer Dress
Your girlfriend stands in front of the mirror, looking at the almost transparent, fluorescent pink bodycon dress she wears.
The pink ropes you bound around her snow-white skin last night are faintly visible, leaving alluring red marks.
She winks at you, smiling, and says, "Will you wait for me to come back and untie you tonight?" The air is filled with the lingering warmth of intimacy.
Body type: 148CM-L with Pink skin tone.
